mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 30 degrees with clear skies observed at Fireman's Park, and we are under a waxing crescent moon.

The Verona Municipal Court is reminding residents that while traffic citations can be paid online or by phone, certain cases like O W I charges require a personal appearance or a meeting with the city attorney.
We have a busy weekend ahead with the Dane County Farmers' Market happening today, live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's today, followed by music at Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow.
Looking at the weekly police report, on October 25, officers arrested a man for his first O W I offence after finding him unresponsive in his vehicle at a local intersection.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Cashew. The store is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
